list.title: Tags
list.description: Define the tags that each kind of item can use. Tags are added and removed on the items' own pages (file manager, users).

scope.fileDescription: Files and folders share this set: select items in the file manager to tag them, and filter by tag.
scope.userDescription: Tag users from their details; the user list can be filtered by tag.
scope.galleryDescription: Tag images from the gallery viewer or in bulk; the gallery can be filtered by tag.

delete.title: Delete tag
delete.confirm: After deleting "{{name}}", it's removed from every item that has it. This can't be undone.
